notes_for_editor: This is the Idaho County Kelly Mountain (45.42264, -116.11289). Do not merge it with us-id-kelly-mountain, which is the Kootenai County site near Coeur d'Alene with its own 1934 pole tower story. Sources date the platform to 1930 and the tower to 1938, and agree on the 1958 destruction. No source names staff for this site, so the story has no staffing paragraph. No source describes the site today. The drive-up label is Idaho Fire Lookouts' own; no source states an access level, so access is omitted.
